Abandoned: Left behind and no longer wanted or cared for.
Abnormal: Not normal; strange or unusual in a way that may be worrying.
Absolute: Complete and total. Absolute zero is the coldest temperature possible.
Abyssal: Very deep, like the deepest parts of the sea. From abyss, a hole so deep it seems to have no bottom.
aCentauri: Alpha Centauri: the star system closest to our Sun. In the game it comes from the Galacticraft space addons.
Acidic: Containing acid; sour, and able to eat away at other things.
Aer: Latin for air. In the Thaumcraft mod it is also the magic aspect of air.
Air: The invisible mix of gases around the Earth that we breathe.
Alfheim: In old Norse stories, the land of the elves. In the Botania mod it is a magic elf world.
Aluminium: A light, silver-white metal used in cans, foil and planes. This is the British spelling.
Aluminum: A light, silver-white metal used in cans, foil and planes. This is the American spelling.
Amber: A hard yellow-orange stone made from very old tree sap. Also the warm orange-yellow color of it.
Americium: A radioactive metal made by people in nuclear reactors. Small amounts are used in smoke alarms.
Ancient: Very old; from a time long, long ago.
Apatine: A changed spelling of apatite, a green or blue mineral used to make plant food.
Apatite: A mineral, often green or blue, that is rich in phosphorus and used to make plant food.
Aqua: Latin for water. In the Thaumcraft mod it is also the magic aspect of water.
Arcane: Secret and mysterious, known only to a few people; often linked to magic.
Arcane Shard: A shard is a small broken piece of something hard. Here it is a magic crystal piece from the Hardcore Ender Expansion mod.
Ardite: A made-up orange-yellow metal from the Tinkers' Construct mod, found in the Nether.
Argon: A gas with no color or smell that is part of the air. It is used in light bulbs and welding.
Arid: Very dry, with little or no rain.
Arsenic: A gray chemical element that is a strong poison.
Ash: The soft gray powder left after something burns.
Ashen: Pale gray, like ash. Also used for a face that has lost its color from fear or illness.
Astral Silver: Astral means of the stars. A magic kind of silver in the game, used in magic mods.
Attuned: Tuned to something; able to sense it or work well with it.
Auric: Of or like gold. From the Latin word aurum, gold.
Austere: Very plain, hard and strict, without comfort. Also used for dry, harsh land.
Avenging: Punishing someone for a wrong they did; taking revenge.
Aware: Knowing or noticing what is around you or what is happening.
Azure: A bright blue color, like a clear sky.
Barnarda: Barnard's Star: a small red star close to our Sun. In the Galacticraft space addons it has planets you can visit.
BarnardaC: Barnard's Star C: a planet around Barnard's Star, a small red star near our Sun. From the Galacticraft space addons.
BarnardaE: Barnard's Star E: a planet around Barnard's Star, a small red star near our Sun. From the Galacticraft space addons.
BarnardaF: Barnard's Star F: a planet around Barnard's Star, a small red star near our Sun. From the Galacticraft space addons.
Barren: Land where few or no plants can grow. Also not able to have babies.
Batty: Informal word for a little crazy or silly. Here also a joke: like a bat.
Bedrockium: A made-up, very heavy metal from the Extra Utilities mod, made from bedrock, the unbreakable bottom layer of the world.
Beefy: Big and strong. Also tasting like beef, the meat of cows.
Big Bad: The main villain of a story, like the Big Bad Wolf in fairy tales.
Black: The darkest color, like the night sky with no light.
Black Plutonium: A made-up, very dark and strong kind of plutonium (a radioactive metal) from the game's space mods.
Bleached: Made white or pale by the sun or by chemicals.
Blooming: Having flowers that are open. Also growing or doing very well.
Blossom: A flower, especially on a fruit tree.
Blue: The color of a clear sky or the deep sea.
Blutonium: A made-up blue radioactive metal from the Big Reactors mod. The name mixes blue and plutonium.
Boggy: Wet and soft like a bog, a swamp where your feet sink in.
Botanic: About plants and the study of plants. Also a nod to the Botania magic mod.
Bovine: About cows, or like a cow.
Brainy: Very clever; having a lot of brains.
Bronzed: Made the color of bronze, a brown-gold metal. Also skin made brown by the sun.
Brown: The color of earth, wood or chocolate.
Caelestis: Latin for heavenly; of the sky.
Caffeinated: Containing caffeine, the thing in coffee and tea that keeps you awake.
Callisto: A large, icy moon of Jupiter, covered with craters.
Callisto Ice: Ice from Callisto, a large frozen moon of Jupiter.
Catty: Mean in a quiet, sneaky way. Here also a joke: like a cat.
Caustic: Able to burn or eat away things by chemical action. Also very unkind in words.
Celebratory: Done to celebrate a happy event, like a party.
Centauri: Short for Alpha Centauri, the star system closest to our Sun. From the Galacticraft space addons.
Ceres: A dwarf planet in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter, named after the Roman goddess of farming.
Certus: Latin for sure or certain. Here it means Certus Quartz, a made-up crystal from the Applied Energistics mod.
Chad: Internet slang for a very confident, cool man. Here a joke name, likely a nod to GTNH players.
Chaos: Complete disorder and confusion. In the Thaumcraft mod it is a magic element of disorder.
Chaotic: In complete disorder; with no order or plan.
Charmed: Under a magic spell. Also very pleased or delighted.
Chrome: Short for chromium, a hard, shiny silver metal often used to coat car parts and taps.
Clay: Soft, sticky earth that becomes hard when baked. It is used to make bricks and pots.
Coal: A black rock that burns well and is used as fuel.
Cobalt: A hard, silver-gray metal. Also a deep blue color made from it.
Conductive Iron: A metal mix from the Ender IO mod: iron mixed with redstone so it carries power well.
Coolant: A liquid used to stop machines or engines from getting too hot.
Copper: A soft reddish-brown metal used in wires and pipes.
Corroded: Slowly damaged or worn away by rust or chemicals.
Corrosive: Able to slowly destroy metal and other things by chemical action.
Cosmic Neutronium: Neutronium is super-heavy matter found in dead stars. Cosmic Neutronium is a made-up metal from the Avaritia mod.
Creepy: Strange and a little scary. Also a nod to the Creeper, the exploding Minecraft monster.
Crumbling: Breaking into small pieces; slowly falling apart.
Cryolite: A rare white mineral used in making aluminium.
Cryotheum: A made-up, extremely cold liquid from the Thermal Expansion mod.
Cultivated: Grown or raised by people, not wild. Also polite and well educated.
Cyan: A bright green-blue color, like the color of tropical sea water.
Cyanite: A blue waste material from the Big Reactors mod, left over after nuclear fuel is used up. Also a real blue mineral.
D-O-B: A made-up name, likely an in-joke or a nod to a player or developer.
Damp: A little wet, often in an unpleasant way, like air in a swamp or cellar.
Dark Steel: A strong, dark metal from the Ender IO mod, made by mixing iron with coal and obsidian.
Darkened: Made dark or darker, with little or no light.
Decaying: Slowly rotting or breaking down, like old food or dead plants.
Decomposing: Rotting and slowly breaking down into smaller parts, as dead plants and animals do.
Deimos: The smaller of the two moons of Mars. It is named after the Greek god of fear.
Demonic: Like a demon: evil and cruel, as if from hell.
Derpious: A made-up word from the internet slang 'derp', meaning silly or clumsy.
Desh: A made-up metal from the Galacticraft mod, found on Mars.
Desolate: Empty, without life or people; lonely and sad.
Diamandi: A made-up Latin-like word for diamond.
Diamond: A very hard, clear, shiny gem made of carbon. It is used in jewelry and in cutting tools.
Diligent: Working hard and carefully, without giving up.
Distilled: Made pure by boiling a liquid and collecting the steam as it cools.
Doctoral: About a doctor or a doctor's degree. Here also a joke about the TV show Doctor Who.
Draconic: Like a dragon. In the game, it also points to Draconium, a strong metal from the Draconic Evolution mod.
Dragon Essence: A magic item from the Hardcore Ender Expansion mod that holds the power of the Ender Dragon.
Dragonblood: The blood of a dragon. Also the name of a dark red tree resin used in dyes and medicine.
Drake: An old word for a dragon. It also means a male duck.
Dreaming: Seeing pictures and stories in your mind while you sleep.
Earth: The ground and soil we walk on. In old belief, one of the four basic elements, with air, fire and water.
Earthen: Made of earth, clay or soil.
Ebony: A very dark black color, named after a hard black wood.
Ectoplasma: A ghostly substance from the Hardcore Ender Expansion mod. Ectoplasm is the slime that ghosts are said to leave.
Edenic: Like Eden, the perfect garden in the Bible: beautiful, peaceful and full of life.
Elastic: Able to stretch and then go back to its first shape, like rubber.
Eldritch: Strange and scary in an unnatural or magical way.
Electrical Steel: A metal from the Ender IO mod, made by mixing steel with silicon. It is used in machines and electric parts.
Electrotine: A blue electric dust from the Project Red mod, used to make circuits.
Electrum: A natural mix of gold and silver, pale yellow in color. People used it for coins in ancient times.
Embittered: Angry and unhappy because of bad things that happened in the past.
Emerald: A bright green precious stone, used in jewelry.
Empowering: Giving power, strength or confidence to someone or something.
Enceladus: A small, icy moon of Saturn with water under its frozen surface.
Enchanted: Under a magic spell; also, filled with delight.
End Dust: Dust from the End, the dark world where the Ender Dragon lives in Minecraft.
Ender: From the End, the dark world in Minecraft where Endermen and the Ender Dragon live.
Ender Shard: A small piece of crystal holding the magic of the End, the dark world of Endermen in Minecraft.
Enderium: A dark green-blue metal from the Thermal Expansion mod, made with Ender pearls.
Enderman Head: The head of an Enderman, the tall, dark creature in Minecraft that can teleport.
Endium: A made-up metal from the Hardcore Ender Expansion mod, found in the End.
Energetic: Full of energy; active and lively.
Energetic Alloy: A golden metal from the Ender IO mod, made by mixing gold, redstone and glowstone.
Energy: The power that makes things move, work or get hot, such as electricity.
Esmeraldi: A made-up Latin-like word for emerald.
Esoteric: Secret or hard to understand; known only by a small group of people.
Essentia: Latin for essence. In the Thaumcraft mod, it is the liquid magic that things are made of.
Ethereal: Very light and delicate, as if not from this world; like a ghost or spirit.
Europa: An icy moon of Jupiter, with a large ocean under its frozen surface.
Europium: A rare soft silver metal, a chemical element. It is used to make the red and blue light in screens.
Excited: Very happy and full of energy because of something good.
Exotic: Strange and interesting because it comes from a faraway country.
Explosive: Able to explode, or likely to explode suddenly.
Farmed: Grown or raised on a farm.
Farmerly: Like a farmer, or having to do with farming.
Fermented: Changed by tiny living things, such as yeast, that turn sugar into alcohol or acid, as in wine or yogurt.
Fertilizer: A substance put on soil to help plants grow better.
Fiendish: Very cruel or evil, like a devil. Also used for something very clever or hard.
Fire: The heat, light and flames made when something burns. In old belief, one of the four basic elements.
Fire Essence: A magic item from the Hardcore Ender Expansion mod that holds the power of fire.
Firestone: A red gem from the Railcraft mod, found in Nether lava. It burns for a very long time as fuel.
Firey: Another spelling of fiery: full of fire, or very hot and bright. Also means full of strong feeling.
Floral: About flowers, or decorated with flowers.
Fluix: A made-up purple crystal from the Applied Energistics 2 mod, made from Certus Quartz, Nether Quartz and redstone.
Fluorine: A pale yellow, very reactive and poisonous gas, a chemical element. It is used in toothpaste in safe forms.
Flux: Constant change or flow. In the Thaumcraft mod, it is harmful waste magic that pollutes the world.
Force: Strength or power; a push or pull that makes things move.
Forest: A large area of land covered with trees.
Forlorn: Sad and lonely, because you have been left alone.
Fossilised: Turned into a fossil: old plant or animal remains that have slowly become rock.
Frugal: Careful with money or food; using only what you need.
Fuchsia: A bright purple-pink color, named after a flower.
Fungal: About fungi, like mushrooms and mold.
Galvanized: Covered with a thin coat of zinc to stop rust. It also means made suddenly active or excited.
Ganymed: The German spelling of Ganymede, the largest moon of Jupiter and the biggest moon in our Solar System.
Ghastly: Very scary or very bad. Also pale like a ghost, and a nod to the Ghast in Minecraft.
Glacial: Very cold, like ice; also about glaciers, the huge slow rivers of ice.
Glittering: Shining with many small flashes of light.
Glowering: Looking at someone in an angry way. Here also a pun on glowing and glowstone.
Glowstone: A glowing yellow block from the Nether in Minecraft. It gives off light and breaks into glowstone dust.
Glutinous: Sticky, like glue. Often used for rice or food that sticks together.
Gnawing: Biting something again and again, like a mouse does. Also a worry or pain that will not go away.
Gold: A soft, shiny yellow metal that is very valuable. It is used in jewelry, coins and electronics.
Gray: The color between black and white, like ash or a cloudy sky.
Green: The color of grass and leaves.
Growing: Getting bigger, or becoming more over time, like a plant.
Hateful: Full of hate; very unkind and cruel. Also something that makes people hate it.
Haume: Short for Haumea, a small egg-shaped dwarf planet far beyond Neptune. It spins very fast.
Hazardous: Dangerous; able to cause harm or damage.
Helium: A light gas with no color or smell. It makes balloons float and is used to cool things to very low temperatures.
Hermitic: Like a hermit: a person who lives alone, away from other people, often for religious reasons.
Heroic: Very brave, like a hero. Doing great and daring things to help others.
Hydra: A monster from Greek myths with many snake heads that grow back when cut off. Also a boss in the Twilight Forest mod.
Hydrogen: The lightest gas and the most common element in the universe. It burns easily and is part of water.
Icy: Very cold, or covered in ice. Also used for a cold, unfriendly manner.
Imperial: Of an empire or an emperor. Also grand and royal.
Indigo: A deep blue-purple color, between blue and violet. Also a plant used to make blue dye.
Indium: A soft, silvery metal. It is used in touch screens and flat TV and phone screens.
Industrious: Hard-working; always busy doing useful work.
Infectious: Able to spread from one person to another, like a disease. Also used for a laugh or feeling that spreads.
Infernal: Of hell, or like hell. Also used to mean very annoying or awful.
Infinity: Without any end or limit. In the game, the strongest metal, from the Avaritia mod.
Infinity Catalyst: A made-up item from the Avaritia mod, used to make Infinity metal. A catalyst is something that helps a change happen.
Infused Gold: Gold filled with magic power. A made-up material in the game, mined on other planets.
Invar: A real metal mix of iron and nickel. It hardly grows or shrinks with heat, so its name comes from invariable (not changing).
Io: A moon of Jupiter. It has more active volcanoes than any other place in the solar system.
Iridium: A very hard, heavy silver-white metal. It does not rust easily and is very rare on Earth.
Iron: A strong gray metal, the most used metal in the world. It is used to make steel and rusts in wet air.
Jaded: Tired and bored because you have had or seen too much of something.
Jaegermeister: Jägermeister is a German herbal alcohol drink. The name is German for master hunter.
Jupiter: The biggest planet in our solar system, fifth from the Sun. It is a giant ball of gas.
Kevlar: A very strong man-made plastic fiber. It is used in bulletproof vests, ropes and tires.
Krypton: A gas with no color or smell, found in tiny amounts in air. It is used in some bright lamps.
Lapis: Short for lapis lazuli, a deep blue stone used in jewelry and to make blue paint. In Minecraft, a blue ore used for enchanting.
Lapotron: A made-up energy crystal from the IndustrialCraft 2 mod, made with lapis. It stores a lot of power.
Lavender: A plant with small purple flowers and a sweet smell. Also a light purple color.
Lead: A soft, heavy gray metal. It blocks radiation but is poisonous to people.
Leaden: Made of lead, or dull gray like lead. Also feeling heavy and slow.
Ledox: A made-up icy material from the space mods in the game, found on far-away planets.
Leporine: Of or like a rabbit or hare.
Lich: In stories, a dead wizard who uses dark magic to live forever. Also a boss in the Twilight Forest mod.
Light Blue: A pale, soft blue color, like a clear sky.
Light Gray: A pale gray color, close to white.
Lime: A small green sour fruit, like a lemon. Also a bright yellow-green color.
Lithium: The lightest metal. It is soft and silver, and is used in phone and car batteries.
Lordly: Like a lord: noble and grand, or proud and acting above others.
Lustered: Having a shine or gloss on the surface, like polished metal.
Lutetium: A rare, silver-white metal. It is one of the rare earth metals and is very expensive.
Machinist: A person who builds, uses or fixes machines and machine tools.
Majestic: Very grand and beautiful in a way that makes you feel respect, like a king or queen.
MakeMake: Makemake is a dwarf planet far beyond Neptune. It is named after a god of the people of Easter Island.
Malicious: Wanting to hurt or harm others on purpose.
Manganese: A hard, gray metal. It is mostly added to steel to make it stronger.
Manyullyn: A made-up purple metal from the Tinkers' Construct mod, made by mixing cobalt and ardite.
Mars: The fourth planet from the Sun, called the Red Planet because of its red, dusty ground.
Marshy: Wet and soft like a marsh: low land that is often full of water and plants.
Meadows: Fields of grass and wild flowers.
Mercury: The smallest planet and the closest to the Sun. Also a silver metal that is liquid at room temperature.
Merry: Happy and cheerful, as in Merry Christmas.
Meteoric Iron: Iron that comes from meteorites, rocks that fell from space. In the game, it is found on the Moon and in meteors.
Mica: A real shiny mineral that splits into very thin, clear sheets. It is used in electronics because it blocks electricity and heat.
Miranda: A small icy moon of Uranus, with huge cliffs and strange patterns on its surface.
Miry: Muddy and wet, like a swamp. Mire means deep mud.
Mithril: A light, very strong silver metal from the stories of J. R. R. Tolkien. In the game, a made-up magic metal.
Modest: Not proud about yourself; simple and not too big or showy.
Monastic: Of monks or a monastery: a quiet, simple life of prayer.
Moon: The Moon goes around the Earth and lights up the night sky. Also any natural body that goes around a planet.
Mutable: Able to change, or likely to change.
Mysterious: Strange and hard to understand or explain.
Mysterious Crystal: A made-up crystal from the space mods in the game, found on far-away planets.
Mystical: Having a secret, magic or spiritual meaning that is hard to understand.
Mytryl: A made-up metal from the space mods in the game, found on far-away planets. Its name sounds like mithril.
Naga: Snake-like beings from Hindu and Buddhist myths. Also a giant snake boss in the Twilight Forest mod.
Nameless: Having no name, or a name that is not known.
Naquadah: A made-up metal from the TV show Stargate. In the game, a powerful radioactive metal used for advanced machines.
Naquadria: A made-up, more powerful and unstable form of Naquadah, from the TV show Stargate. In the game, a radioactive material.
Natural: Coming from nature, not made by people.
Neighsayer: A joke on naysayer, a person who always says no or doubts things, and neigh, the sound a horse makes.
Neodymium: A silvery rare earth metal. It is used to make very strong magnets.
Neon: A gas with no color that glows bright red-orange in electric signs.
Neptune: The eighth and farthest planet from the Sun. It is a cold, blue giant planet.
Nether Shard: A shard is a small broken piece. The Nether is the hot, fiery world below in Minecraft.
Netherite: A very strong dark metal from newer versions of Minecraft, made from ancient debris found deep in the Nether.
Neutronium: A made-up super-heavy metal in the game. The name comes from neutron stars, dead stars whose matter is packed extremely tight.
Nexus: A central point where many things connect or meet.
Nickel: A hard silver-white metal, used in coins, batteries and to make steel that does not rust.
Nitrogen: A gas with no color or smell. It makes up most of the air we breathe.
Noble: Having good, honest and generous qualities. Also a person from a high-ranking family.
Nuclear: About the center (nucleus) of atoms, and the large energy they give off, as in nuclear power.
Oberon: A large moon of the planet Uranus, named after the king of the fairies in a Shakespeare play.
Oblivion: The state of being completely forgotten, or of not knowing what is happening around you.
Ocean: A very large area of salt water that covers much of the Earth.
Oil: A thick dark liquid found under the ground, used to make fuel and plastic. Also any greasy liquid.
Oily: Covered in or full of oil; greasy.
Olivine: A green mineral found in rocks. Its clear gem form is called peridot.
Orange: The color between red and yellow, like the fruit of the same name.
Order: A neat, planned arrangement where everything is in its place. In the Thaumcraft mod it is one of the basic magic elements (Ordo).
Ordered: Arranged in a neat, regular way, following a clear pattern.
Oriharukon: A made-up metal in the game. The name comes from a metal in the game Lineage II, based on orichalcum, a metal from old Greek stories.
Osmium: A very hard, heavy blue-gray metal. It is the densest natural element.
Oxygen: A gas with no color or smell in the air. People, animals and fire need it.
Peat: Soft brown soil made of old dead plants in wet land. It can be dried and burned as fuel.
Phantasmal: Like a ghost or a dream; not real, or strange and hard to believe.
Phobos: The larger of the two small moons of the planet Mars.
Phosphorus: A chemical element found in bones and plants. One form glows in the dark and burns easily; it is used in matches.
Pink: A pale red color, like the color of many flowers.
Platinum: A rare, heavy silver-white metal worth more than gold. It is used in jewelry and car parts.
Plumbum: Latin for lead, the soft heavy gray metal. It is why lead's symbol is Pb.
Pluto: A small, icy dwarf planet far out past Neptune. It was called the ninth planet until 2006.
Plutonium: A heavy radioactive metal made in nuclear reactors. It is used in nuclear power and bombs.
Poultry: Birds kept on farms for eggs or meat, such as chickens, ducks and turkeys.
Prehistoric: From the very old time before people wrote history down, like the age of dinosaurs.
Primeval: From the earliest times of the world; very old and wild.
Prismatic: Showing many bright colors, like light passing through a glass prism to make a rainbow.
Proteus: A moon of the planet Neptune, named after a sea god from Greek stories who could change his shape.
Prussian: From Prussia, an old German state. Here it means Prussian blue, a deep dark blue color.
Pulsating Iron: A green-tinted iron alloy from the Ender IO mod, mixed with ender pearl. Pulsating means beating like a heart.
Pupil: A student, someone who is learning. Also the black center of the eye.
Pure: Clean and not mixed with anything else.
Purple: The color made by mixing red and blue.
Pyrotheum: A hot, fiery magic dust from the Thermal Expansion mod. The name comes from Greek pyro, meaning fire.
Quantium: A made-up metal from the Galacticraft space addons, found on other planets.
Quantum: The smallest possible amount of energy. Also the science of tiny things like atoms, where strange rules apply.
Quicksilver: An old name for mercury, a silver metal that is liquid at room temperature.
Rare Earth: A group of 17 metals used in magnets, screens and electronics. They are not truly rare, but hard to separate.
Ravening: Very hungry and greedy, hunting for food like a wild animal.
Red: The color of blood or fire.
Red Alloy: A mix of copper and redstone used in the game to make electric wires and parts.
Red Garnet: A dark red gemstone. Garnets are common minerals used in jewelry.
Redstone: A red dust in Minecraft that carries power like electricity, used to build machines and circuits.
Redstone Alloy: A metal mix from the Ender IO mod, made with redstone and silicon. It is used in electric parts.
Refined: Made clean and pure by removing unwanted parts, like refined oil or sugar. Also polite and elegant.
Rejuvenating: Making someone or something feel young, fresh and full of energy again.
Relic: An object that survives from the far past, often kept because it is old or special.
Resilient: Strong enough to recover quickly after being hurt or bent.
Resinous: Full of or like resin, the thick sticky liquid that comes out of trees.
Ripening: Becoming ripe, like fruit that is getting ready to eat.
River: A large natural stream of water that flows across land to the sea or a lake.
Robust: Strong and healthy; hard to break.
Rocky: Full of rocks, or hard like rock.
Rooted: Fixed in the ground by roots; firmly held in place.
Rune: A letter from old northern European alphabets, often thought to have magic power.
Rural: About the countryside and farms, not towns or cities.
Rusty: Covered in rust, the red-brown layer that forms on iron when it gets wet.
Saffron: A costly spice from crocus flowers. Also its bright yellow-orange color.
Salis Mundus: Latin for salt of the world. In the Thaumcraft mod it is a magic dust used to make magic tools.
Salt: White crystals found in sea water, used to give flavor to food.
Sandwich: Food made of two slices of bread with something like cheese or meat between them.
Sapphire: A precious gemstone, usually deep blue.
Saturn: The sixth planet from the Sun, a large gas planet famous for its bright rings.
Savant: A person who knows a great deal, or is very gifted in one area.
Scholarly: Liking study and learning, like a teacher or researcher.
Scummy: Covered in scum, a dirty layer on top of a liquid. Its text is a joke about the grog drink from the pirate game Monkey Island.
Seaweed: Plants that grow in the sea, such as kelp.
Secluded: Hidden away from other people; quiet and alone.
Sepia: A red-brown color, like very old photos. It once came from the ink of the cuttlefish.
Shadow Metal: A dark magic metal from the magic mods in the game.
Sheepish: Shy or embarrassed after doing something silly. Also like a sheep.
Shining: Giving off or reflecting bright light.
Silicon: A gray element found in sand and rock. It is used to make computer chips.
Silver: A shiny gray-white precious metal, used in jewelry, coins and electronics.
Silverfish: A small silver-gray insect without wings that lives in homes. In Minecraft it is a small enemy that hides in stone.
Sinister: Seeming evil or dangerous; making you feel something bad will happen.
Skeletal: About or like a skeleton; very thin, only bones.
Skulking: Hiding or moving around secretly, often with bad plans.
Skystone: A hard black stone from the Applied Energistics mod, found in meteorites that fell from the sky.
Slate: A dark gray stone that splits into thin flat sheets, used for roofs. Also a dark blue-gray color.
Slimeball: A small ball of green slime dropped by slimes in Minecraft. It is sticky and used to make things like sticky pistons.
Smouldering: Burning slowly with smoke but no flame. Also used for strong feelings that are hidden but still there.
Snow Queen: A queen of ice and snow from fairy tales. In the Twilight Forest mod, she is a boss who lives in a frozen castle.
Sodden: Very wet; full of water, like ground after heavy rain.
Solum: Latin for soil or ground. In the Thaumcraft mod, it is also an aspect (a type of magic) for earth.
Somnolent: Sleepy, or making you feel sleepy.
Sorcerous: Having to do with sorcery, which means magic, often dark magic.
Soul: The part of a person that is not the body, which many people believe lives on after death.
Space: The huge empty area beyond the Earth's air, where the stars and planets are.
Spatial: Having to do with space: where things are, how big they are and how far apart they are.
Spectral: Like a ghost; pale and not quite real.
Spidery: Like a spider, for example thin and long like a spider's legs.
Spirit: A ghost, or the part of a person that is not the body. Also means energy and courage.
Spiteful: Wanting to hurt or upset others on purpose; mean.
Stained: Marked with spots of color that are hard to remove, such as ink or coffee.
Stainless Steel: A kind of steel mixed with chromium so that it does not rust. Used for kitchen sinks and knives.
Stannum: Latin for tin. That is why the chemical symbol for tin is Sn.
Stardust: Very small bits of matter from stars floating in space. Also a magic item from the Hardcore Ender Expansion mod.
Steadfast: Firm and loyal; does not change or give up.
Steel: A very strong metal made from iron and a little carbon. Used for buildings, cars and tools.
Sticky: Sticking to things you touch, like glue or honey.
Sticky Resin: A thick sticky liquid from trees. In the IndustrialCraft mod, it comes from rubber trees and is made into rubber.
Sugary: Containing a lot of sugar; very sweet.
Sulfur: A yellow chemical element that smells bad when it burns. Used to make gunpowder and acids.
Sunnarium: A made-up glowing material from the Advanced Solar Panels mod, made from sun-like energy and used in strong solar panels.
Supernatural: Something that cannot be explained by nature or science, like ghosts or magic.
Sweetened: Made sweet by adding sugar or honey.
Tainted: Spoiled or made dirty. In the Thaumcraft mod, Taint is a purple corruption that spreads and harms living things.
Tarnished: Dull and dark on the surface, like old silver or metal that has lost its shine.
Tarry: Covered with tar, or thick, black and sticky like tar.
TCeti: Tau Ceti: a star a bit like our Sun, about 12 light-years away. A place you can visit in the Galacticraft space mods.
TCetiE: Tau Ceti e: a planet that may go around the star Tau Ceti, near our Sun. A place to visit in the Galacticraft space mods.
Tea: A drink made by putting the dried leaves of the tea plant in hot water.
Thaumic Shards: Small magic crystal pieces from the Thaumcraft mod. Thaumic means having to do with Thaumcraft magic.
Thauminite: A made-up magic metal from the Thaumic Bases mod, made with Thaumium.
Thaumium Dust: Powder of Thaumium, a magic metal from the Thaumcraft mod made by mixing iron with magic.
Thorium: A silver-gray radioactive metal. It can be used as fuel in nuclear reactors.
Thriving: Growing well and strong; healthy and successful.
Timely: Happening at the right time; not late. The bee's Latin name is a joke about the TV show Doctor Who.
Tin: A soft silver-white metal. Used to cover steel cans and mixed with copper to make bronze.
Tipsy: A little drunk from alcohol, so you feel happy and a bit unsteady.
Titan: The biggest moon of the planet Saturn, with a thick orange sky. Also a giant from old Greek stories.
Titanium: A light, very strong silver metal that does not rust. Used in planes and medical parts.
Tolerant: Able to accept things or people that are different. Also able to live in hard conditions.
Transmuting: Changing one thing into a different thing, like turning lead into gold in old stories.
Tricky: Hard to deal with, or liking to play tricks on people.
Trinium: A made-up very strong space metal, taken from the TV show Stargate. In GregTech it is found on far planets.
Triton: The biggest moon of the planet Neptune. It is very cold and goes around Neptune backwards.
Tropical: From the tropics, the hot and wet parts of the world near the equator, with jungles.
Tungsten: A very hard, heavy gray metal that melts only at very high heat. Used in old light bulbs and tools.
Turquoise: A blue-green color, and the blue-green stone it is named after.
Unknown Liquid: A liquid that no one has named or understood yet. In this modpack, a strange liquid found in space.
Unstable: Not steady; likely to change, fall or break suddenly.
Unusual: Not common; different from what is normal.
Unweary: Not tired; able to keep going.
Ur Ghast: A huge ghast boss from the Twilight Forest mod. Ur means first or original, so it is like the first of all ghasts.
Uranium: A heavy, radioactive silver metal. It is used as fuel in nuclear power plants.
Uranus: The seventh planet from the Sun. It is a cold blue-green gas giant that spins on its side.
Valiant: Very brave, especially in a fight.
Valuable: Worth a lot of money, or very useful and important.
Vazbee: A play on Vazkii, the name of the person who made the Botania mod.
Vega: One of the brightest stars in the night sky, about 25 light-years away. A place you can visit in the Galacticraft space mods.
VegaB: Vega B: a made-up planet around the bright star Vega, from the Galacticraft space mods.
Vengeful: Wanting to hurt someone back because they hurt you.
Venus: The second planet from the Sun. It is very hot, with thick clouds. Also the Roman goddess of love.
Vibrant Alloy: A made-up green metal mix from the Ender IO mod, made with Energetic Alloy and Ender Pearls.
Vindictive: Wanting to hurt someone who hurt you; not willing to forgive.
Virulent: Very harmful and spreading fast, like a strong disease. Also very angry and full of hate.
Vis: Latin for force or power. In the Thaumcraft mod, vis is the magic energy in the air.
Viscous: Thick and slow to flow, like honey or oil.
Void: A completely empty space with nothing in it. In Thaumcraft, Void Metal is a dark magic metal.
Volcanic: Having to do with volcanoes, the mountains that throw out hot melted rock and fire.
Walrus: A big sea animal with long tusks that lives in cold northern seas. Here probably a place name from the space mods.
Water: The clear liquid that falls as rain and fills rivers and seas. All living things need it.
Watery: Full of water, or too thin and weak, like watery soup.
White: The color of snow or milk.
Windy: With a lot of wind blowing.
Wintry: Like winter; cold, snowy or icy.
Wispy: Thin, light and soft, like a wisp of smoke or hair. In Thaumcraft, wisps are small floating magic spirits.
Wither: To dry up and die, like a plant without water. Also a three-headed boss monster in Minecraft.
Withering: Making things dry up and die. Also used for a look or words that make someone feel small.
Xenon: A rare gas with no color or smell, found in tiny amounts in air. Used in bright lamps.
Yellorium: A made-up yellow radioactive metal from the Big Reactors mod, used as fuel in its reactors.
Yellow: The color of lemons or the sun.
Yellow Garnet: A yellow kind of garnet, a gem stone. In GregTech it is a gem you can mine.
Zinc: A blue-white metal. Used to protect steel from rust and mixed with copper to make brass.
